raw: {"findings": [{"category": "construction", "severity": "advisory", "where": "right end of the goggles and the left strap end", "evidence": "The strap attaches only on the left lens, with just a small nub on the right side, and the left end of the strap stops abruptly, so it could not form a working loop around a head."}, {"category": "construction", "severity": "advisory", "where": "thin brass bar across the top between the two lenses", "evidence": "A flat rod runs from the left lens rim to the right lens rim above the leather bridge without a clear mount, so it reads as floating or unattached."}], "verdict": "pass"}

findings.where: right end of the goggles and the left strap end
findings.evidence: The strap attaches only on the left lens, with just a small nub on the right side, and the left end of the strap stops abruptly, so it could not form a working loop around a head.

findings.where: thin brass bar across the top between the two lenses
findings.evidence: A flat rod runs from the left lens rim to the right lens rim above the leather bridge without a clear mount, so it reads as floating or unattached.
